subject: [pool] opus-pool: started vcodec DMA pool enlargement (patch 0313, recipe build_q10jh.sh)
body: Finding so far: the RWVC pool (and camera/JPEG claims) live BELOW XNU's RAM window (XNU = 0x1_42000000 + 3776 MiB), so a bigger pool costs iOS no RAM. Plan: relocate the pool to a free <4 GB range listed against the live FDT mblock table (candidate 0xA0000000.., between SCP-reserved 0x9fa00000+5M and vpu_binary 0xbd6c0000). Will post the final PA/size + image sha. Daemons read pool_pa/pool_bytes from RWVC_INFO; please tell me if anything hardcodes 0xda800000/0x5600000.
